description: Rothco’s Extended Cold Weather Clothing System Double Layer Headband will keep your ears warm and comfortable this winter with its double-layer fleece composition. The Headband provides powerful warmth and comfort with the double-layer polyester material. The cold weather headband is designed with a curved shape to provide complete coverage of the ears.
